_meta.note: `limit` must be clamped to [1, 1000]. The default when the parameter is absent or unparseable stays 300, matching the current implementation.
_meta.currentBehavior: lib/events-api.js does `parseInt(req.query.limit, 10) || 300` with no bound. ?limit=99999999 is honoured verbatim (an unbounded scan); ?limit=0 falls through the `||` to 300; ?limit=-5 reaches SQLite as `LIMIT -5`, which SQLite treats as no limit at all.
_meta.clamp: limit = Math.min(1000, Math.max(1, parsed))  — applied after the parse, with the 300 default when the parse yields NaN
